note: Agent-proposed bounded WP4A envelope (slice 1 of WP4); see docs/workstreams/wp4a-schema-g4-v1alpha4.md. WP4B registry/reference closure/San adapter, WP4C F.5 assignability and WP4D CEL remain queued.

fixtures.title: Valid G.4 Schema documents are accepted
fixtures.input: Object/closed, nullable union, array bounds, independent $ref and string enum/const Schemas.
assertions: No SCHEMA_INVALID is emitted for the allowed keyword set.
Nullable [T, "null"] declarations are accepted.
Annotations alone are accepted.
A $ref annotated with $schema/$id is accepted.

fixtures.title: Unsupported composition, pattern and $defs keywords are rejected
assertions: Each unsupported keyword is rejected as SCHEMA_INVALID/C_STATIC.
Unknown keywords are never silently ignored.
The generic Draft 2020-12 keyword set does not broaden the CA-SL profile.

fixtures.title: Type unions are restricted to [T, "null"]
fixtures.input: General union [string, integer], single-member union and duplicate member union.
assertions: General unions are rejected.
Exactly two distinct members with one null are required.
No arbitrary union is accepted through a library default.

fixtures.title: required, constraint and type consistency is enforced
fixtures.input: required not a declared property; non-boolean additionalProperties; tuple items; inverted bounds; incompatible constraint types.
assertions: required must be a unique subset of declared properties.
additionalProperties must be boolean.
items must be one Schema.
Inverted or type-incompatible constraints are rejected.

fixtures.title: $ref independence and fragment rejection
fixtures.input: $ref combined with a sibling assertion and $ref containing a JSON Pointer fragment.
assertions: $ref may only be accompanied by the permitted annotations.
#/... fragments are rejected.
Dynamic/remote reference forms are not accepted.

fixtures.title: enum/const literal consistency
fixtures.input: Duplicate enum values plus enum/const values incompatible with the declared type and constraints.
assertions: Duplicate enum values are rejected.
Literal values must be accepted by the declared type and constraints.
No implicit coercion of literal values is performed.

fixtures.title: Request Schema root shape is enforced in Check/Build
fixtures.input: Request Schema root open, non-object or missing properties; also an unsupported nested keyword.
assertions: Request Schema root must be object with properties and additionalProperties: false.
SCHEMA_INVALID retains the Schema source path/line/column.
Check and Build agree on the diagnostic.

fixtures.title: Every Skill-owned Schema is validated
fixtures.input: An unused Skill-owned Schema file under schemas/ uses an unsupported keyword.
assertions: Validation is not limited to the Contract-referenced Request Schema.
The diagnostic names the offending Schema file.
No G.4 violation is silently ignored.

fixtures.title: Missing Request Schema keeps the frozen missing diagnostic
fixtures.input: Contract declares requestSchema but the Skill-owned file is absent.
assertions: Missing Request Schema is REQUEST_SCHEMA_MISSING, not SCHEMA_INVALID.
The diagnostic retains the Contract source location.
No Schema is inferred from other files.
